notes:
WHY THIS APP NEEDS com.apple.security.network.server

PowerBoard listens for and responds to incoming network connections. It runs an HTTP and WebSocket server inside the app, bound to loopback at 127.0.0.1:4318, and that server accepts incoming connections from two clients:

1. The app's own window. PowerBoard's entire user interface is loaded from http://127.0.0.1:4318 (see loadURL in the main process). Every board read, every edit and every export is an incoming HTTP or WebSocket request to that listener. Without the server entitlement the socket cannot bind, the window has nothing to load, and the app is unusable — this is not an optional or background capability.

2. Local AI assistant clients. The same listener serves a Model Context Protocol endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:4318/mcp. AI coding assistants the user already runs on the same Mac (for example Claude Code) connect INTO PowerBoard to read and edit the open board. PowerBoard is the server in that exchange; the assistant is the client.

The client entitlement alone cannot cover either case, because both are inbound connections to a socket this app opens and listens on.

Scope: the bind address is the hardcoded string "127.0.0.1" — never 0.0.0.0 and never a LAN address — so the listener is reachable only from processes on the same Mac and is not visible to other devices on the network. Nothing is sent off the machine, and the app talks to no server of ours.

To verify: launch PowerBoard and open any board — the interface you see is being served over that loopback listener. Running "lsof -nP -i :4318" while the app is open shows the loopback-only bind.

ABOUT THE APP

PowerBoard is a design board for app mockups and diagrams. It works fully offline, with no account and no sign-in. Open it and draw.

The AI-agent feature above is optional and off the critical path. Every feature named in the description — drawing, mockups, diagrams, connectors, screenshot tracing, comments, undo, backups and all export formats — works with nothing connected. To see the feature, open a board and choose Connect agent in the top bar; the dialog shows the endpoint and setup steps. No AI client is needed to review the app.

There is nothing to purchase: no trial, no subscription, no in-app purchases.

Boards are stored as JSON inside the app container, with compressed snapshot backups also inside the container. The app collects no user data.
